  "size": "large",
  "title": "Multi-browser living-room E2E + rename visual→e2e (#98)",
  "summary": "Adds a five-context living-room night with seeds and page objects, adopts them across visual specs, and rewires the harness for snapshots and UI Mode. Loosens dependencies to ranges and ships an audit report, a QR fix, and mechanical renames.",
  "why": "Single-surface goldens cannot catch pairing, presence, break mode, or cross-client sync bugs [bugs](source:s1). The goal is one scripted living-room night proving that contract [night](source:s1).",
  "lookFor": [
    "Issue [#98](source:s1) asks that living-room sleeps and races be called out in the PR. The [PR](source:s2) only checks the 10× flake box. The spec header documents the 12.5s TTL wait, playback touch, and heartbeat waits, and no source names why the PR omits them.",
    "[PR](source:s2) says `pnpm test:e2e:ui` sets `E2E_UI=1` and skips webServer for an instant list. `package.json` runs plain `--ui` with no env and `playwright.config.ts` only skips on `E2E_HARNESS_ONLY=1`. UI Mode still starts `server.sh` with fresh Convex, and no source names why the skip went away.",
    "The [commit](source:s3) says it pins Playwright to 1.62.1. `package.json` bumps to `^1.62.1` and loosens 30+ exact pins to `^` ranges. No source explains the broad loosening beyond the Playwright bump."
  ],

      "name": "living-room",
      "summary": "Covers lobby through break, TV close, and finish in five contexts."
    },

      "name": "page-objects",

    },

      "name": "harness",

    },
    {

    }
  ],
